recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-28294 unless the Vocabulary/Terminology Infrastructure work group later decides the THO pCLOCD page or Infoway canonical URL should change outside this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-28294 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Vocabulary change request for R5 asking to add a pCLOCD (pan-Canadian LOINC Observation Code Database) page or external-tab entry on terminologies-systems. The Jira resolution says the work had been done.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies pre-applied git commit 1021ba87da0392fc3823d7465ed464ef55558ec4. That commit added the pCLOCD row to source/terminologies-systems.html with the Infoway canonical URL, pCLOCD source label, a local Using pCLOCD page link, and OID 2.16.840.1.113883.2.20.5.1.
additional_context: Current source keeps the pCLOCD row in source/terminologies-systems.html, and source/hierarchy.xml places terminologies-systems.html in the active Terminology > Code Systems page tree. Later Published issue FHIR-35933 moved the external-code-system usage pages from FHIR core to THO and commit 81e5862f203fdb8a03e9c943a7cf455aba8973f4 updated the pCLOCD row to point to https://terminology.hl7.org/pCLOCD.html. UP-70 separately records the UTG/THO pCLOCD metadata cleanup. Confluence Vocabulary minutes from 2021-07-07 record FHIR-28294 as persuasive and pre-applied.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already contains the requested pCLOCD external-code-system entry, and its current THO link reflects the later FHIR-35933 migration rather than a missing local core page.
